title: Nightmare Before Christmas display
eyebrow: 64 x 48 display on 12 Technic 16 x 16 bricks · courtyard, mountains, spiral platform and toy shop niche
intro: The full display: 12 white Technic 16 x 16 bricks pinned together with 102 black Technic pins, the plates, snow strip and road on top, the sideways-masonry courtyard, then the mountains layer by layer, peak by peak, with the toy shop niche span and the spiral platform. The mountains are hollow: inside each one only the support pillars that hold up the courses above are built. 4,788 pieces to build, plus one tan 6 x 6 plate that only marks where the 21351 spiral sits (it is not a part to buy). Lime pieces are hidden (mostly the inner support pillars): no face of them shows once the display is finished, so build them in any colour you have spare.

sections.name: Mountains: layers 13-16, niche span and spiral platform

parts_note.text: Lime means a hidden piece (mostly inner support pillars): it can't be seen in the finished display, so any colour works.
